description: Source code for the SampleApplication class, which manages an OpenGL ES rendering context using ANGLE, handles window creation, event processing, and rendering loop.

classes.name: SampleApplication
classes.description: A class that encapsulates an ANGLE-based OpenGL ES rendering application, managing window creation, event handling, and rendering loop.

methods.name: SampleApplication
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the application with parameters, processes command-line arguments to select ANGLE back-end and device type, and loads necessary libraries.

methods.name: ~SampleApplication
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up EGL and OS windows.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the application; currently a stub returning true.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources; currently a no-op.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Per-frame update logic; currently a no-op.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main application loop handling window events, rendering, and cleanup.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key release events; default no-op.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key press events; default no-op.
